name: lem-maincb-corner-equivalence
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-maincb-corner-equivalence — There is a universal e_sim > 0 such that, for every finite family of one-dimensional t-projections P_1,...,P_m in an extended t-C*-algebra with t <= e_sim, the relation j ~ k iff dim S_{P_j,P_k} = 1 is an equivalence relation.
